protocol: active Windows formal v4; train=1370, test=343, no validation; test AUPRC monitor; max 100; patience 2
setting: S0-Raw and CVER: full-pixel segmentation, all queries, geometry post-hoc only. Historical S2-Raw: geometry-derived G10/G01 qmask weights KD queries as w=1+m; not compliant with the later geometry-post-hoc-only rule.

teacher_provenance.note: CG0/SG0 use gamma=0. CG10/SG10 use gamma=0.10 TGD geometry-specific supervision. Historical S2-Raw used CG10; current geometry-free Search-KD runs use CG0.

cver.pool: 3 FPN levels x 9 fixed offsets (3x3, feature-pixel units)
cver.utility: ReLU(level-attention x grad*activation removal benefit) under teacher uniform fixed-pool readout, TAU=1
cver.B: listwise KL with target mass on Teacher-positive candidates only
cver.scorer: light q/k 1x1-conv dot-product scorer (only added params)

s2_repro: Historical verbatim student_search_kd_v2.py arm S2: policy JS + same-target-memory evidence cosine, G10/G01 query weighting (w=1+m), first-batch calibration, KD fraction 0.10. Geometry enters KD through qmask_raw(ga,gd); retained as historical reference only.
